question: Who among the following is the first bowler to bowl two maiden overs in the Indian Premier league match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohammad Siraj.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Mohammed Siraj became the** first bowler to bowl two maiden overs **in an Indian Premier League (IPL) match.
 
• He plays for **Royal Challengers Bangalore**** (RCB).**
 
• Siraj achieved the feat **against Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR)** at the Sheikh Zayed Stadium in Abu Dhabi.
 
• The 26-year-old took two wickets in his first over without conceding a run and followed it up with another wicket maiden against KKR today.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Praveen Kumar** bowled the most number of Maiden overs in IPL HIstory.
 
• He bowled a total of **14 overs Maiden.**
